theme.rationale: Ambiente imersivo de leitura e estudos noturnos, destacando as cores pastéis saturadas Catppuccin Mocha solicitadas pelo usuário sobre um fundo profundo e focado.

typography.font_family_sans: Plus Jakarta Sans Variable, system-ui, sans-serif

entry_surfaces./: split hero showcase — atmospheric gallery introduction left with search & filter dock, real 3D interactive book carousel & shelf right
entry_surfaces./book/:id: split study workbench — responsive PDF reader viewport (left 60%) + persistent AI interactive study assistant & note companion (right 40%)
entry_surfaces./admin/login: focused security portal — minimalist dark card with Catppuccin accent borders and Clerk/admin credentials flow
entry_surfaces./admin: dense management studio — book catalog CRUD table, drag-and-drop PDF uploader, color-coded generated cover previewer and metrics

grids_and_layouts.gallery_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8 px-6 py-8
grids_and_layouts.pdf_pane: lg:col-span-7 xl:col-span-8 h-full flex flex-col border-r border-[#313244] bg-[#181825]
grids_and_layouts.chatbot_pane: lg:col-span-5 xl:col-span-4 h-full flex flex-col bg-[#1e1e2e]

book_3d_transform.card_style: transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.4s ease;
book_3d_transform.hover_effect: transform: rotateY(-22deg) rotateX(8deg) translateZ(20px) scale(1.04); box-shadow: -15px 20px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
book_3d_transform.spine_effect: position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 14px; height: 100%; transform: rotateY(-90deg) translateX(-14px); transform-origin: left; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.35);

motion.transitions: transition: color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.2s ease

accessibility.contrast_compliance: All body texts meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio against their background surfaces (#cdd6f4 on #1e1e2e is 11.5:1; #a6adc8 on #1e1e2e is 7.2:1).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Support @media (prefers-reduced-motion) disabling intensive 3D rotations and keeping subtle opacity transitions.

image_urls.description: Library atmosphere with warm books for subtle dark ambient overlay banner
Book pile cover art for realistic library demo books

component_hierarchy.navigation: Navbar with brand logo, search bar quick-toggle, categories dropdown, 'Sala de Estudos' link, and Admin access badge
component_hierarchy.book_gallery_card: Interactive 3D book object featuring realistic spine, edge page depth, user palette badge, category pill, and action CTA ('Abrir Leitor & Estudo')
component_hierarchy.generated_cover_canvas: Dynamic aesthetic cover generator using typography (Lora + JetBrains Mono) with geometric borders and user's Catppuccin palette for books without image files
component_hierarchy.pdf_reader_module: PDF viewer with page jumper, zoom in/out, fit-width, continuous scroll / single page toggle, text search, and bookmarking
component_hierarchy.study_ai_assistant: Side panel with streaming chat, book context pill, suggested prompt chips ('Resumir este capítulo', 'Principais conceitos', 'Gerar quiz de 3 perguntas'), and remaining daily question counter
component_hierarchy.admin_curation_suite: Admin dashboard with quick stats (Total Livros, Categorias, Leitores Ativos), book management modal, PDF drag-drop uploader, cover color selector, and delete confirmation dialog

instructions_to_main_agent: Language is strictly pt-BR across all user interfaces, tooltips, buttons, and chatbot placeholders (e.g. 'Galeria de Livros', 'Ambiente de Estudos', 'Pergunte à IA sobre o livro...', 'Páginas', 'Administração').
Implement the 3D book card using CSS 3D transforms (preserve-3d, rotateY, rotateX on hover, realistic drop-shadow with amber/blue glow tint) for smooth 60fps performance on all devices.

For books uploaded without a cover image, automatically generate a beautifully styled typographic cover using one of the preset user palette colors (#585b70, #f38ba8, #a6e3a1, #f9e2af, #89b4fa, #f5c2e7, #94e2d5).

The reader view on route /book/:id must feel like a dedicated study environment: full height layout, distraction-free PDF viewer on left/center with rich controls, and integrated AI assistant on the right panel.

Include a simulated/real streaming study chatbot response with simulated token streaming or backend LLM endpoint, default suggested quick-prompts relevant to reading and a remaining daily question badge (e.g. 'Perguntas hoje: 8/10').
Admin routes: /admin/login (email/password login flow) and /admin (CRUD catalog, upload PDF files, edit metadata, delete books). Public routes require zero login.

Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements: 'book-card-{id}', 'book-read-button-{id}', 'pdf-zoom-in', 'pdf-zoom-out', 'pdf-next-page', 'pdf-prev-page', 'ai-chat-input', 'ai-chat-send-btn', 'admin-login-submit', 'admin-add-book-btn', 'category-filter-{category}'.
Ensure dark mode is applied by default in index.html with class='dark' and rich Catppuccin Mocha tokens in index.css.
